info.name: Taxido API - All App APIs
info.description: Generated from registered first-party Laravel API routes. Includes all /api routes from the app and enabled modules, grouped for admin, driver, rider/user, mobility, authentication, and shared APIs. Set baseUrl to the host root (local default: http://127.0.0.1:8000). Path parameters are editable in each request. Authenticated requests use the collection token variable; successful email/password login requests save access_token automatically. Request bodies are starter templates; replace them with endpoint-required fields. Browser-only web pages and external payment callbacks outside /api are not included.
